title: Harvest Baskets

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Every harvest, we make a basket for each neighbour who can't get out to the fields: old Mrs. Ada, the Millers, and the new family by the river.

intro.speaker: ruth
intro.text: Will you share the apples so every basket has the same?

steps.speaker: ruth
steps.prompt: Share the apples so every basket has the same.

older.prompt: Share nineteen apples among four baskets. What shall we do with any left over?

feedback.all_good: Four each. Nobody forgotten, and nobody left out.

outro.speaker: ruth
outro.text: The harvest isn't really in until everyone has their share. Shall we carry them round together?

journal_line: I shared out harvest baskets for the neighbours with Mrs. Ruth.
